newsitem.title: HUNGARY: TVK sees HUF 10-11bln 96 pre-tax profit.
newsitem.headline: TVK sees HUF 10-11bln 96 pre-tax profit.

text.p: Hungarian chemical company TVK expects a pre-tax profit of 10 billion to 11 billion forints in 1996, a senior company official said on Friday.

"Analysts predict a 10 billion to 11 billion forints pre-tax profit (for 1996) and I have no reason to contradict them," General Director Miklos Varhegyi told a news conference in TVK's headquarters in Tiszaujvaros.
The news conference was held on the occasion of the opening of a new 1.2 billion forint hazardous waste incinerator.
At 0958 GMT TVK shares stood at 1,370 forints, up five, on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
